abstract: Evaluates vacuum-jacketed containment certification and dedicated cryogenic buffer capacity
system_message:
You are Cryogenic Systems Specialist (CRYO). The Cryogenic Systems Specialist (CRYO) is responsible for evaluating vacuum-jacketed containment certification and dedicated cryogenic buffer capacity across marine bunkering candidate supply consortia, alongside monitoring daily boil-off reliquefaction performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Boil-off gas management（BOIL）
information_points.content:
CRYO-BOIL-7OY：Process instrumentation logs for North Sea Clean Fuels Consortium indicate a daily boil-off reliquefaction rate of 99.1% during active storage tests across shore tanks.
CRYO-BOIL-QP3：Process instrumentation logs for Celtic Marine Hydrogen Alliance document a daily boil-off reliquefaction rate of 99.8% during active storage tests across shore tanks.
CRYO-BOIL-IOE：Process instrumentation logs for Baltic Zero-Carbon Joint Venture record a daily boil-off reliquefaction rate of 98.5% during active storage tests across shore tanks.

information_points.title: Evaluates vacuum-jacketed containment certification and dedicated cryogenic buffer capacity（SPEC）
information_points.content:
CRYO-SPEC-OXC：For Celtic Marine Hydrogen Alliance, classification society evaluation indicates that cryogenic containment integrity certification has not been approved for bunkering transfer skids and double-walled insulated tanks under international cryogenic pressure vessel standards. Terminal allocation records specify a dedicated buffer reserve of 100 t maintained as a permanent minimum liquid hydrogen reserve in on-site cryogenic vacuum storage spheres dedicated exclusively to this supply contract.
CRYO-SPEC-V6L：For North Sea Clean Fuels Consortium, classification society evaluation confirms that cryogenic containment integrity certification has been formally approved for bunkering transfer skids and double-walled insulated tanks under international cryogenic pressure vessel standards. In addition, terminal allocation records specify a dedicated buffer reserve of 40 t maintained as a permanent minimum liquid hydrogen reserve in on-site cryogenic vacuum storage spheres dedicated exclusively to this supply contract.
CRYO-SPEC-WYO：For Baltic Zero-Carbon Joint Venture, classification society evaluation confirms that cryogenic containment integrity certification has been formally approved for bunkering transfer skids and double-walled insulated tanks under international cryogenic pressure vessel standards. Terminal allocation records specify a dedicated buffer reserve of 100 t maintained as a permanent minimum liquid hydrogen reserve in on-site cryogenic vacuum storage spheres dedicated exclusively to this supply contract.
